result_class_rules.SUPPORTED_MATCH: strict/sensitivity positive reference + compatible monitor rule + localized object/carrier identity; sequence constraints pass when available
result_class_rules.PARTIAL_LOCALIZATION: positive reference + compatible monitor rule, but source/carrier identity is unavailable or not localized
result_class_rules.MISS: positive observable reference has no compatible prospective monitor candidate
result_class_rules.AUDIT_REJECTED_WARNING: monitor candidate maps to an explicit NEGATIVE_BOUNDARY reference with compatible family/localization
result_class_rules.UNSUPPORTED_WARNING: monitor candidate has no positive or negative adjudication sufficient to confirm/reject it, including NOT_ESTABLISHED-only evidence
result_class_rules.UNOBSERVABLE_REFERENCE: reference is positive/candidate but required evidence surface is unavailable and no legal source-bound match can be adjudicated

denominators.primary_warning_precision: warnings matched to SUPPORTED references / all monitor warnings
denominators.candidate_inclusive_warning_support: warnings matched to SUPPORTED or SUPPORTED_CANDIDATE / all monitor warnings

anti_tuning_rules: No rule-to-family mapping may be changed after primary monitor outputs are joined to the sealed reference set.
No candidate threshold or sequence window may be tuned from realized monitor performance.
A monitor warning cannot inherit a CPR label from the audit.
Audit misses cannot create replacement prospective monitor candidates.
G1 is excluded from primary performance denominators.
